BiblicalUsage: Beth-Car means house of the ram, and it is named once, in 1 Samuel 7:11, as the limit of a victory: the men of Israel pursued the Philistines and smote them until they came under Beth-car. A place on the Philistine side of the line, remembered because Israel's pursuit stopped there.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sets the limits of our victories too, and Beth-car is where this one ended.
